    by calling spi_master_put, but the remove function does not have this

    Reported-by: Dongliang Mu <mudongliangabcd@gmail.com>
    Fixes: 454fa271
bic_trace_step.reason: The remove function at line 788 contains `spi_master_put(spicc->master)`, which manually drops a reference. According to the root cause, probe uses `devm_spi_register_controller()` so the devm cleanup will automatically call `spi_controller_put()` on device removal. This manual call causes a double-put. The fix (removing the line) is not yet present in this commit, so the vulnerable construct remains.

    Signed-off-by: Neil Armstrong <narmstrong@baylibr
